description: This is a React-like UI component for a Settings page in a Smart TV Weather Hub app. It manages user preferences such as units (Celsius/Fahrenheit), default location, and favorites. Includes reactive state management, focus navigation via remote control, and UI rendering with Lightning.js.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Lightning.js component representing the Settings page with UI for units, location, and favorites customization.

methods.name: computeSubtitles
methods.description: Computes and updates subtitle texts for location and favorites sections.

methods.name: favKey
methods.description: Returns a unique key string for a favorite item.

methods.name: favTitle
methods.description: Returns the display title for a favorite item.

methods.name: favSub
methods.description: Returns the subtitle or region for a favorite item.

methods.name: setFocusArea
methods.description: Sets the current focus area for navigation.

methods.name: moveUnitsFocus
methods.description: Moves focus index within unit options.

methods.name: moveLocationFocus
methods.description: Moves focus index within the curated location list.

methods.name: moveFavoritesActionFocus
methods.description: Moves focus within favorites action buttons.

methods.name: moveFavoritesListFocus
methods.description: Moves focus within the list of favorite locations.

methods.name: applyUnitsSelection
methods.description: Sets the units preference based on current focus.

methods.name: applyLocationSelection
methods.description: Sets the selected location based on current focus.

methods.name: addCurrentToFavorites
methods.description: Adds the current selected location to favorites.

methods.name: removeFocusedFavorite
methods.description: Removes the favorite item currently focused.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back in the routing history.
